interpretation.selection: All prespecified TF groups/guides retained; insufficient-cell guides explicitly unevaluable
interpretation.response: Existing per-guide cell-level Mann-Whitney/BH across all features and absolute d>0.5
interpretation.sign: Feature response change sign only; not regulatory activation/repression
interpretation.retrieval: Absolute feature d mapped through fixed catalogue to the same h5ad gene universe; direct factor excluded
interpretation.uncertainty: Descriptive only; no guide-level CI, no resampling of two/few guides, no paired-significance claim
interpretation.dependence: All guide pairs share fixed controls; pairs and feature columns are not independent replicates
interpretation.low_power: Few cells per guide can yield no shared significant responses; empty-union Jaccard is undefined
interpretation.scope: One recorded HTO partition; not independent culture/batch replication
